Scene:
可是夹竹桃的毒很重，让他肚子很痛。他在地上躺着，觉得他快会死了。可是正好有别人找到他了，给了他一个像伞的植物，叫灵芝。他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好，不再生病了。他测量起来了，像星星的植物是毒，像伞的植物是药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 可是正好有别人找到他了：有人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别人：一个人，“别人” distinguishes other people from a stated speaker or group, so it does not introduce an unknown helper in this narration; “一个人” introduces the new character clearly. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别人：一个男人，“别人” distinguishes other people from a person already under discussion; here the rescuer is being introduced for the first time, so use a full noun phrase instead. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: Both runs identify the misuse of “别人” for introducing a new helper and replace it with an acceptable indefinite person phrase.
